messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired -> PD:METR-INGEST-LAG (critical). Trigger: metering-ingest-consumer lag > 75k msgs for > 10m. Potential customer invoice delay. Paging alice_oncall and ben_sre :rotating_light:

pagerduty-bot: Incident created: METR-INGEST-LAG. Primary: alice_oncall. Escalation policy: 5m -> ben_sre -> devon_runtime. Link: https://pd.example/incidents/METR-INGEST-LAG

alice_oncall: ack'd. I'm on it, joining channel. Can someone paste the latest consumer-lag metric?

ben_sre: looking. grafana: https://grafana/redwood/d/ingest/consumer-lag shows spike at 15:12 UTC. Consumer group "metering-ingest" stuck at partition 6-10. consumer_offsets >> latest.

alice_oncall: running quick check for stalled pods. `kubectl -n ingest get pods -l app=metering-consumer`

ben_sre: saw two pods in CrashLoopBackOff. Logs show java OOM on rebalancing:
```
2026-03-14T15:09:03Z ERROR consumer: OutOfMemoryError: Java heap space
...GC overhead limit exceeded
```

carmen_billing: heads-up: two enterprise customers (AcmeCorp, BlueWave) have usage windows closing tonight; if ingestion delayed their token counts won't show up for invoices. Need ETA asap.

alice_oncall: bumping priority to page. I'm going to spin up replacement consumer replicas with increased heap, and force reassign partitions to healthy pods. Command: `kubectl -n ingest scale deployment metering-consumer --replicas=6`

devon_runtime: add note: there's an ongoing wall of small messages that floods memory due to large multipart requests. We should add backpressure but for now scaling should help.

ben_sre: scaled to 6. Watch logs: `kubectl -n ingest logs -f deployment/metering-consumer`

fiona_support: pinged AcmeCorp CSM, they saw lower than expected counts via support ticket #9876. CSM asks for ETA and whether we'll waive late invoice adjustments.

alice_oncall: after scale, consumers rebalanced and lag started dropping at 15:28. Some messages were duplicated in the backlog because commit offsets were not incremented before the crash. Need to run dedupe/backfill job to reconcile token counts.

devon_runtime: starting dedupe job now: `python tools/metering_backfill.py --start 2026-03-14T14:00Z --end 2026-03-14T15:20Z --strategy=de-dup-by-eventid`

ben_sre: monitoring. kafka offsets progressing again. Current lag down to ~3k. Will keep an eye for re-occurrence.

carmen_billing: important: dedupe job output must be verified before invoices run. If job is delayed >2h we'll need to block invoicing and communicate to finance. Please add status updates.

alice_oncall: acknowledged. Adding temporary tag to the incident: `invoice-risk` and `customer-impact: enterprise`.

pagerduty-bot: Reminder: if incident not resolved in 30m escalate to oncall-lead.

devon_runtime: dedupe run completed at 15:45. Found ~42k duplicated token events across the window, corrected counts for AcmeCorp and BlueWave. Output: `backfill_report_1798765432.csv` uploaded to s3://redwood-incidents/1798765432-backfill_report.csv

fiona_support: CSM notified, AcmeCorp support replied: "appreciate fast response, will delay invoice run for us until we confirm counts". BlueWave ok with auto-adjust.

ben_sre: no further CrashLoop restarts in last 20m. Consumer heap increased from 1g -> 3g. Will open follow-up PR to add circuit-breaker and better memory limits.

alice_oncall: marking incident as mitigated at 15:50. Root cause: memory pressure during rebalance caused commits to fail, creating duplicate processing. Mitigation: scale consumers, run dedupe backfill, and postpone affected invoices while counts reconcile.

carmen_billing: will hold AcmeCorp invoice and raise finance alert. Filing a blocker for tonight's invoice job: FIN-BLOCK-1798765432.

devon_runtime: filing runtime bug #RUNTIME-512: consumer-oom-on-rebalance, attaching logs and backfill report. Suggested fixes: incremental commits, backpressure on large multipart payloads, circuit-breaker on memory.

alice_oncall: passing to ben_sre for post-incident write-up and to devon for remediation. On-call handoff in 30m to eva_oncall — leaving notes in the incident doc.

ben_sre: will draft postmortem, include timeline, metric graphs, command history, and follow-up tasks.

pagerduty-bot: Incident METR-INGEST-LAG status changed to: mitigated by alice_oncall. Please run the post-incident checklist: https://wiki.redwood/incident-checklist

alice_oncall: closing thread here. If anyone sees lag re-emerge open a new pager. :slightly_smiling_face:
